entries.description: An invented animal, plant, person or other living being (B2531).
A weapon, trap, hunting or catching tool, poison, or meant to hurt (youth protection).
Uses a material that is not in reach, or uses it in an impossible way.
Needs a higher tech level than the world has.
Too big or too much effort; a smaller version is possible.
Could not really be made or used this way.
Does not help with what the inhabitant wanted (B2668).
Relies on a property of a material the inhabitant does not know - nothing it noticed, tried or heard says so (B2578, can it come to it).
